mobbin:afb6188a-6313-41c8-a2b6-c19e7f876.summary: User connects Google (or Outlook/iCloud), accepts Calendar/Email/Contacts permissions that include writing meetings, picks main calendar and which calendars count for availability, then sets weekly work hours.
steal: Permissions copy states write behaviors: create meetings, sync events, block times (step 1) — makes two-way explicit.
Main calendar = default write target when creating events (step 3).
Separate 'calendars that belong to you' for availability vs holiday noise (steps 4–5).
Skip calendar connect; still create meetings in-app (step 0).
avoid: Email/Contacts scopes on the same screen may be heavier than Essentials needs for Outlook sync.
mobbin:afb6188a-6313-41c8-a2b6-c19e7f876.fit: Best cheap pattern for Outlook/Google sync setup: provider → scopes → write-target calendar → busy calendars → work hours; maps to conflict detection without building Motion's AI scheduler.
